name: sidekick
description: Checks your message before it is sent, by rules and, where worthwhile, briefly with Haiku 5.5 (Sonnet 5.5 writes rewritten versions in level auto): a hint line under your message or a question (new chat with handoff, a skill, a clearer version, or "wrong chat?" when the message belongs to another project). Names due maintenance once per chat (/skill-doctor, prompt-audit, consolidate-memory, /init). With worklist installed, a long message with several tasks can be split into 3-4 to-dos, and /later plans text as to-dos. Five levels (off, cache, guide, plan, auto) with a colored label in the prompt footer. /savings shows cost and measurable savings at a glance, /savings detail compares the models over time.
